notes: Google Columbus @ 2027-07-01: Building 5 operational. The [transmission line construction notice](https://www.aeptransmission.com/ohio/docs/Hartman%20Farms%20Extension%20No.%202%20138%20kV%20Transmission%20Line%20Project%20Construction%20Notice.pdf) that expands site by 100 MW is assumed to be entirely for Building 5, and has an in-service date of July 1, 2027 (page 3). Estimate taken on the safe side based on completion times for Building 3-4 from when roof was complete. | Google New Albany @ 2026-08-16: Building 5 is operational. Estimated from the high-res image from May. | Google Council Bluffs (East) @ 2026-06-10: Building 3 is operational. Assuming it takes 2 months to install all 7 cooling towers, then another 3 months for final touches and commissioning. | Google Omaha @ 2026-06-30: Building 3 is operational (estimate). Based on there being minimal construction work as of May 15. | Google Storey County @ 2027-06-30: Building 3 is estimated to be operational. We estimate the operational date by analogy to the time that Building 1 took to go from a foundation to being operational.
